div.h1: Add product: one form instance, steps as data, bound fields
div.p: The values of every step live in one TanStack Form instance, "Dalej" checks the current step only, a field on screen is one bound component.

text.tspan: list of products in React state
values of all 15 fields + meta per field
stepIndex in React state next to it
only the current one is on screen
each reads and writes its own fields
the step schema ignores the other steps' keys
messages land in each field's meta
registers the field, provides it through fieldContext
data-invalid on the wrapper, aria-invalid on the control

g.text: errors shown under the mounted fields
